positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "In 1973, the Supreme Court ruled abortion to be a Constitutional right - one of the worst decisions in American history. Today, the Supreme Court heard oral arguments in a case coming from Mississippi, Dobbs v Jackson Women's Health, that could finally overturn Roe v Wade."

"The right to life is a fundamental, Constitutional and moral principle. I'm proud of @LynnFitchAG for taking the battle all the way to the Supreme Court. I pray this is the case that overturns Roe v Wade & puts us on the path to ending abortion in America."
"Today marks the one-year anniversary of the Dobbs decision. While we should celebrate life today and every day, the pro-life mission is not over."
Voted in favor of HR 26 "Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act"

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "Across the nation, violent crime rates are skyrocketing. At the same time, progressive prosecutors are letting serial criminals go free. Radical activists have pushed to "defund" the police, and retirement and retention rates for law enforcement officers are moving in the wrong direction."
"Mike will fight any and all efforts to defund the police, and he'll make sure our men and women in law enforcement have the support they need to keep us safe."

"To protect our communities, we must stand up for law and order. As a member of the House Committee on Homeland Security, I'm fighting to ensure that law enforcement is able to do its job and keep criminals off the streets."

"With over 40 years of experience in law enforcement, Mike Ezell knows what it takes to protect our communities. He'll stand up against the radical left's pro-crime policies, which have led to spikes in violent crime across the country."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "He'll fight to ensure that our servicemen and women are properly equipped and protected to defend freedom at home and abroad. Mike will oppose the radical left's attempts to cut our defense budget, which would leave our military under-prepared and under-equipped."

"I was proud to vote for @HouseGOP's FY2024 NDAA, which increases military readiness and takes on the woke agenda. Our military budget should be focused on supporting and equipping servicemembers, not pushing CRT and gender-transition surgeries."
Voted in favor of HR 2670 "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024"
Voted in favor of HR 4365 "Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2024"
